title: 📈 OP-17 meta shakeup — Nico Robin package prices spike
body: The new OP-17 format is repricing the market: Nico Robin 062 Parallel nearly doubled to ~$137, Gum-Gum Giant (Alt Art) to ~$923, with affordable movers like Miss Doublefinger still around $31. First OP-17 regional (Ottawa) is 26 Sep.

announcement.news: TCGplayer's 22 September price-trend report shows sharp climbs tied to the new OP-17 format. Highlights: Nico Robin (062 Parallel) +$70.84 → $136.76 after back-to-back Coliseum wins; Gum-Gum Giant (Alt Art) → ~$923; Sabo (3rd Anniversary) → ~$1,747 on the black Elbaph package. In the affordable tier: Miss Doublefinger (Full Art) → ~$31, Charlotte Pudding (Alt Art) → ~$33, Marshall D. Teach (119) → ~$31. Mary Geoise (Alt Art) → ~$25 on OP-18 'Holy Knights' speculation.
announcement.analysis: The English market has already repriced on Coliseum results, but the first big OP-17 regional (Ottawa) isn't until 26 September — so the broader tournament data hasn't landed yet. Limitless still reflects the older OP-16 meta from the July regionals, so expect more movement once OP-17 results circulate.
announcement.value: The cards moving are the tournament-linked ones in the Nico Robin package. The affordable tier — Miss Doublefinger, Charlotte Pudding, Marshall D. Teach, all around $30 — is where smaller budgets can still take part. Just remember these are already post-spike prices, not entry points.
announcement.deadline: First OP-17 regional: Ottawa, 26 September 2026. Results circulating afterward could drive a second move — or a reversal.
announcement.risk: These are post-spike prices, so you'd be buying strength. Tournament-driven spikes reverse fast if the deck doesn't repeat at the regional, and Mary Geoise's rise is pure speculation on an unannounced OP-18 archetype.

title: 🆕 EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' confirmed for late October 2026
body: EB-05 lands ~30–31 Oct 2026 — Nico Robin Leader, SP Nami & Robin, and five leader parallels. The first Heroines set is still sold out.

announcement.news: Bandai has confirmed EB-05 'Heroines Edition Vol.2' for around 30–31 October 2026 (Japan: ¥240 per 6-card pack; English: $4.99 per 12-card pack). Cards revealed so far include a Nico Robin Leader (Green/Yellow), SP versions of Nami and Robin, and leader parallels for Vivi, Shirahoshi, Hancock, Rebecca and Bonney. OP-18 'The Dominance of God' has also been announced, with an estimated ~November window.
announcement.analysis: The first Heroines set (EB-03) is still sold out, which points to strong, lasting demand for heroine cards. Japanese preorders and store lotteries usually open 3–5 weeks before release, so they could open any day now — allocation tends to matter more than the sticker price.
announcement.value: For collectors, the SP Nami and Robin and the leader parallels are the likely chase cards, and early copies at launch are usually the cheapest before hype builds. With EB-03 still sold out, sealed EB-05 could hold its value better than a typical Extra Booster.
announcement.deadline: Release around 30–31 October 2026. The preorder / lottery window has not been announced yet.
announcement.risk: The full card list isn't out yet, so the chase cards could disappoint. Extra Boosters are often reprinted, and a single-card-heavy set can mean softer demand for sealed product.
